title: Encouraging words can be heard differently

captions.physics: Discussing the possibility of direct questions
captions.energy: Preserving hope for an open continuation

meaning: You can speak of more direct questions becoming possible and preserve hope for open continuation, acknowledging the shock of familiar encouraging words meaning different things to you.
text: The Star in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in words about the possibility of more direct questions. The Star in energy supports hope for open continuation without prescribing an obligatory answer. The Tower in emotions brings a sense of being shaken by different meanings in familiar words. You can hope to understand each other better while strongly feeling the loss of earlier certainty.

For example, you say how good it would be to ask directly about readiness to meet. Discussion reveals that “Drop by whenever you like” was understood both literally and as a warm general phrase. **Hope for clarity allows the awkwardness of a discovered difference**. Confidence that the invitation always meant the same thing may waver. You can name this feeling and separately discuss what the words mean today. The mismatch requires neither declaring earlier warmth pretence nor promising faultless understanding of future invitations.

Difficulty arises if restoring certainty requires hope to carry a promise never to speak ambiguously again. Openness becomes an impossible guarantee. The constructive Star in energy helps preserve further understanding as a possibility without prescribing its result. You can clarify a present invitation and acknowledge the strength of an earlier impression; feeling shaken requires neither closing the subject nor replacing living speech with formulas meant forever to exclude every other reading.
